extracted.intended_audience: Users and developers of the GAP computer algebra system (mathematicians/programmers working with algebras, modules, and Lie algebras in GAP)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference guidance for constructing and using algebra homomorphisms, algebra modules, and Lie-algebra-related constructions in GAP; includes preconditions, expected behaviour, and caveats for the provided operations. Targets writing/calling GAP functions correctly and understanding their guarantees and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraHomomorphismByImages preconditions and failure behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: AlgebraHomomorphismByImages returns the algebra homomorphism with source A and range B that is defined by mapping the list gens of generators of A to the list imgs of images in B. If gens does not generate A or if the homomorphism does not exist (i.e., if mapping the generators describes only a multi-valued mapping) then fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may avoid the checks by calling AlgebraHomomorphismByImagesNC; to construct possibly multi-valued mappings use AlgebraGeneralMappingByImages. Example usage in the manual shows constructing bases and calling AlgebraHomomorphismByImages and then Image(f, ...).

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraHomomorphismByImagesNC assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: AlgebraHomomorphismByImagesNC is the operation called by AlgebraHomomorphismByImages. Its methods may assume that gens generates A and that the mapping of gens to imgs defines an algebra homomorphism. Results are unpredictable if these conditions do not hold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this NC variant only when you know the inputs satisfy the required conditions; for possibly multi-valued additive/multiplicative/scalar-respecting mappings use AlgebraGeneralMappingByImages.

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraWithOneGeneralMappingByImages identity behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: This function is analogous to AlgebraGeneralMappingByImages; the only difference being that the identity of A is automatically mapped to the identity of B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you want mappings that respect the multiplicative identity automatically; example shows mapping quaternion algebra basis elements to matrix algebra elements with identity mapping implied.

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImages preconditions and failure behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImages returns the algebra-with-one homomorphism with source A and range B defined by mapping gens of generators of A to imgs in B. Because identity of A is assumed to map to identity of B, gens needs to generate A only as an algebra-with-one. If gens does not generate A or if the homomorphism does not exist then fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To avoid checks call AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImagesNC; to construct possibly multi-valued mappings use AlgebraWithOneGeneralMappingByImages. Example shows mapping single basis element when identity mapping is assumed.

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImagesNC assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImagesNC is called by AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByImages. Its methods may assume that gens generates A and that the mapping of gens to imgs defines an algebra-with-one homomorphism. Results are unpredictable if these conditions do not hold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For multi-valued mappings that respect addition, multiplication, identity, and scalar multiplication use AlgebraWithOneGeneralMappingByImages.

rubrics_metrics.name: AlgebraHomomorphismByFunction / AlgebraWithOneHomomorphismByFunction checking
rubrics_metrics.description: These functions construct an algebra homomorphism from A to B using a one-argument function f. They do not check that the function actually defines a homomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must ensure the provided function f actually defines a valid (algebra-with-one) homomorphism; the manual demonstrates creating such mapping-by-function objects and applying them.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismByIdeal returns algebra homomorphism
rubrics_metrics.description: For an algebra A and an ideal I in A, NaturalHomomorphismByIdeal returns a homomorphism of algebras; in particular the range of this mapping is also an algebra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows using NaturalHomomorphismByIdeal on a Lie algebra centre to get mapping to quotient; ImagesSource(hom) gives the image algebra.

rubrics_metrics.name: OperationAlgebraHomomorphism describes module action
rubrics_metrics.description: OperationAlgebraHomomorphism returns an algebra homomorphism from the F-algebra A into a matrix algebra over F that describes the F-linear action of A on the basis B of a free left module respectively on the free left module V, via the operation opr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homomorphism need not be surjective. The default value for opr is OnRight. If A is an algebra-with-one then the returned mapping is an algebra-with-one homomorphism because the identity of A acts as the identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: NiceAlgebraMonomorphism behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: If A is an associative algebra with one, NiceAlgebraMonomorphism(A) returns an isomorphism from A onto a matrix algebra. If A is a finitely presented Lie algebra, returns an isomorphism onto a Lie algebra defined by a structure constants table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only implemented for certain domain types; see IsomorphismMatrixAlgebra example for matrices result.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismFpAlgebra implementation scope
rubrics_metrics.description: IsomorphismFpAlgebra(A) returns an isomorphism from the algebra A onto a finitely presented algebra. Currently this is only implemented for associative algebras with one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of implementation limitations; example shows QuaternionAlgebra mapped to finitely presented algebra representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismMatrixAlgebra implementation scope
rubrics_metrics.description: IsomorphismMatrixAlgebra(A) returns an isomorphism from the algebra A onto a matrix algebra. Currently this is only implemented for associative algebras with one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates mapping structure-constant algebra (made into algebra-with-one) to a matrix algebra; Image(f, BasisVectors(Basis(A))[1]) returns the corresponding matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismSCAlgebra (w.r.t. a basis) semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: For a basis B of an algebra A, IsomorphismSCAlgebra returns an algebra isomorphism from A to an algebra S given by structure constants, such that the canonical basis of S is the image of B. For an algebra A without specified basis, IsomorphismSCAlgebra chooses a basis and returns that value for that basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show canonical-basis mappings for finite fields and product algebras.

rubrics_metrics.name: RepresentativeLinearOperation existence and failure
rubrics_metrics.description: RepresentativeLinearOperation(A, v, w, opr) returns an element of A that maps the vector v to the vector w under the linear operation described by opr. If no such element exists then fail is returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should check for fail to handle cases where the mapping does not exist; examples show both a successful representative and a fail result.

rubrics_metrics.name: Left/Right/BiAlgebraModuleByGenerators op signature requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The constructors LeftAlgebraModuleByGenerators(A, op, gens), RightAlgebraModuleByGenerators(A, op, gens), and BiAlgebraModuleByGenerators(A, B, opl, opr, gens) build modules generated by gens where the action is described by op/opl/opr. op must be a function of two arguments with specified argument order (algebra element, vector) for left actions and (vector, algebra element) for right actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide op/opl/opr with the correct argument order and semantics. Examples show creating left, right, and bi-modules and that the modules are vector spaces with the algebra actions delegated to the provided functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftAlgebraModule / RightAlgebraModule / BiAlgebraModule op signature requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs modules with underlying vector space V; the action of A (or A and B) is described by op/opl/opr which must be functions of two arguments with the specified argument order (algebra element vs vector).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These forms take an existing underlying space V rather than generators; example constructs modules over Rationals^3 and inspects Dimension(M).

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfAlgebraModule meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: GeneratorsOfAlgebraModule(M) returns a list of elements of M that generate M as an algebra module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to obtain generating set returned by module constructors; example shows the single generator returned for a module constructed from one generator.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAlgebraModuleElement and related category implications
rubrics_metrics.description: If an object has IsAlgebraModuleElementCollection then it is an algebra module. If a family has IsAlgebraModuleElementFamily then it is a family of algebra module elements; every algebra module has its own elements family.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These categorical predicates can be used to test whether objects/collections/families are algebra modules or module elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLeftAlgebraModuleElement / IsRightAlgebraModuleElement categories
rubrics_metrics.description: IsLeftAlgebraModuleElement and IsLeftAlgebraModuleElementCollection mark left algebra module elements/collections. Analogously for right modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of the corresponding collection predicate indicates the object is a left/right algebra module.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftActingAlgebra / RightActingAlgebra / ActingAlgebra semantics and error case
rubrics_metrics.description: LeftActingAlgebra(V) returns the algebra that acts from the left on a left-module V. RightActingAlgebra(V) returns the algebra that acts from the right on a right-module V. ActingAlgebra(V) returns the acting algebra: same as LeftActingAlgebra for left modules, RightActingAlgebra for right modules, and will signal an error if V is a bi-module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate accessor depending on module type; do not call ActingAlgebra on bi-modules (it will error).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBasisOfAlgebraModuleElementSpace delegateBasis property
rubrics_metrics.description: If a basis B lies in the category IsBasisOfAlgebraModuleElementSpace, then B is a basis of a subspace of an algebra module. This means that B has the record field B!.delegateBasis set, which is a basis of the corresponding subspace of the underlying vector space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use B!.delegateBasis to access the underlying vector-space basis; example verifies IsBasisOfAlgebraModuleElementSpace(B) and inspects B!.delegateBasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: MatrixOfAction column/row convention and side parameter
rubrics_metrics.description: MatrixOfAction(B, x[, side]) returns the matrix of the action of x with respect to basis B. If x acts from the left, coefficients of images of basis elements are the columns of the output. If x acts from the right, they are the rows. For bi-modules the side parameter must be 'left' or 'right'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify side for bi-modules. Example shows retrieving the matrix of action for a left module.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubAlgebraModule generation and optional basis hint
rubrics_metrics.description: SubAlgebraModule(M, gens[, "basis"]) returns the sub-module of M generated by gens. If the optional string 'basis' is given, then gens is assumed to form a basis of the submodule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing 'basis' avoids checks and declares that gens are a basis; examples show constructing submodules and checking Dimension(V).

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftModuleByHomomorphismToMatAlg / RightModuleByHomomorphismToMatAlg semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an algebra A and a homomorphism hom from A into a matrix algebra, LeftModuleByHomomorphismToMatAlg(A, hom) returns the left A-module defined by hom; similarly for right modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use after constructing an explicit homomorphism into matrices (e.g., AlgebraHomomorphismByImages) to obtain the corresponding module.

rubrics_metrics.name: AdjointModule definition
rubrics_metrics.description: AdjointModule(A) returns the A-module defined by the left action of A on itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AdjointModule yields a module of dimension equal to dimension of A; examples show forming submodules of the adjoint module.

rubrics_metrics.name: FaithfulModule implementation scope and behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: FaithfulModule(A) returns a faithful finite-dimensional left-module over algebra A. This is only implemented for associative algebras, and for Lie algebras of characteristic 0. It may also work for certain Lie algebras of characteristic p > 0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of type/characteristic restrictions; examples illustrate usage on associative and Lie algebras, showing basis vectors and action results.

rubrics_metrics.name: ModuleByRestriction behaviour for subalgebras
rubrics_metrics.description: ModuleByRestriction(V, sub1[, sub2]) returns the module that is the restriction of V to sub1: same underlying vector space but with acting algebra sub1. If two subalgebras sub1, sub2 are given then V is assumed to be a bi-module, with sub1 acting on the left and sub2 on the right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct subalgebra objects (e.g., Subalgebra(A, ...)) before passing them; example shows restricting a module to a 1-generator subalgebra.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismBySubAlgebraModule projection and quotient
rubrics_metrics.description: NaturalHomomorphismBySubAlgebraModule(V, W) returns the projection from V onto V/W. It is a linear map and also a module homomorphism. The quotient module can be formed by entering V/W.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ImageSource(f) to get the quotient module; PreImagesRepresentative can compute preimages. Example shows forming quotient module and mapping basis/preimages.

rubrics_metrics.name: DirectSumOfAlgebraModules operand requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: DirectSumOfAlgebraModules(list) (or DirectSumOfAlgebraModules(V, W) shorthand) returns the direct sum of given algebra modules. The modules must be defined over the same algebras.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure compatibility of acting algebras; examples show direct sums producing expected combined dimensions and basis vectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: TranslatorSubalgebra semantics and unchecked inputs
rubrics_metrics.description: TranslatorSubalgebra(M, U, W) returns the subspace of elements of the acting algebra A that map U into W. If W is a sub-algebra-module then this space is a subalgebra of A. Works for left or right modules over a finite-dimensional algebra. It is not checked whether U and W are indeed subspaces of M; if not, nothing is guaranteed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely on validation: ensure U and W are legitimate subspaces/submodules. Examples show translator subalgebra returning full algebra dimension or zero dimension depending on U,W.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieObject wrapping semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: LieObject(obj) wraps a ring element obj into a Lie object so that multiplication * on Lie objects is the commutator of the underlying ring elements (r1*r2 - r2*r1). An element is not equal to its Lie element; LieObject of an ordinary matrix is again a matrix but with Lie semantics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of type distinctions between ordinary elements and Lie objects: families, method selection, and domain membership differ. Examples show lo*lo yields LieObject([0...]) while m*m yields ordinary multiplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLieObject and LieFamily distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: IsLieObject predicates detect Lie objects/families. LieFamily(Fam) produces a family in bijection with Fam but with the Lie bracket as multiplication. UnderlyingFamily(Fam) and UnderlyingRingElement(obj) access the original structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embedding(Fam, LieFamily(Fam)) gives the bijection; the bijection respects addition and additive inverses. Use UnderlyingRingElement to recover original ring element from a Lie object.

rubrics_metrics.name: Method installation caution for Lie objects
rubrics_metrics.description: When installing methods for types that may involve Lie elements, be careful: zero element of a matrix space may be an ordinary matrix or its Lie element depending on space; methods must be aware of both cases or method selection must distinguish them explicitly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Either make methods that handle both ordinary and Lie cases or create separate methods requiring explicit IsLieObjectCollection vs non-Lie requirements so only one method applies per case. Similarly, properties like 'full matrix space' may hold for ordinary or Lie matrices, so methods must consider both.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieAlgebraByStructureConstants Jacobi identity not checked
rubrics_metrics.description: LieAlgebraByStructureConstants does the same as AlgebraByStructureConstants, except the result is assumed to be a Lie algebra. Note that the function does not check whether sct satisfies the Jacobi identity. If one creates a Lie algebra this way with a table that does not satisfy the Jacobi identity, errors may occur later on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure provided structure constants table satisfies Lie algebra identities; the function does not validate Jacobi and may produce later errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: RestrictedLieAlgebraByStructureConstants p-map and checks
rubrics_metrics.description: RestrictedLieAlgebraByStructureConstants behaves like LieAlgebraByStructureConstants but assumes the result is a restricted Lie algebra with p-map given by argument pmapping. The pmapping is a list specifying p-th powers of basis vectors. The function does not check whether sct satisfies the Jacobi identity or whether pmapping specifies a legitimate p-mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully construct pmapping in the required format; the manual gives example of a commutative restricted Lie algebra in characteristic 5. Lack of checks means invalid pmapping may cause later errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieAlgebra(L) and LieAlgebra(F, gens[, zero][, 'basis']) semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: For an associative algebra L, LieAlgebra(L) is the Lie algebra isomorphic to L as a vector space but with the Lie bracket as product. LieAlgebra(F, gens) constructs the Lie algebra over field/division ring F generated by Lie objects corresponding to gens. If zero is given it sets the zero element; if final argument is 'basis' then gens are known to form a basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements of gens are wrapped up as Lie objects; even if gens are already Lie elements, the result lies in the Lie family of the family that contains gens. The returned algebra's product is the usual * interpreted as commutator on the wrapped objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeLieAlgebra output basis convention
rubrics_metrics.description: FreeLieAlgebra(R, rank[, name]) returns a free Lie algebra of given rank over ring R. The elements of a free Lie algebra are written on the Hall-Lyndon basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use FreeLieAlgebra with named generators if desired; be aware that the Hall-Lyndon basis is the canonical internal representation.
